answer: A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in dawn, and forge reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 62 aliases, and each one needs its own funded voyage account. The attacker spends 136 dollars and 3 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
